findings.title: S07 PRD consistency blockers and major specification mismatches are fixed

evidence.summary: All original BLOCKER findings F-001, F-005, F-006, and F-014 are marked FIXED; fixed major architecture consistency findings are summarized in the S07 final status notes.

findings.impact: M001 can move from PRD normalization to final architecture reporting without reopening S07-fixed wording issues.
findings.recommendation: Treat S07-fixed items as closed unless new source or runtime evidence contradicts the normalized PRD text.
findings.resolution_path: Carry only the remaining deferred/bounded issues into the final report; cite fixed S07 themes as upstream closure evidence.
findings.verification_criteria: Final report distinguishes fixed PRD consistency work from deferred proof gates and does not reclassify fixed blockers as open.
findings.roadmap_effect: Allows M002 planning to start from normalized PRD documents while preserving explicit proof gates for unresolved architecture risks.
non_goals: No product ETL, production graph schema, KnowQL parser, LegalNexus API, or hybrid retrieval implementation.

findings.title: Same-date multi-edition conflict policy remains deferred

evidence.summary: FR-1a and architecture text define changed-SHA/new-edition behavior, but same-date multi-edition conflict policy remains owned by S08 temporal model.

findings.impact: Without a policy, conflicting consolidated editions for one date may create ambiguous temporal answers and import validation behavior.
findings.recommendation: Define whether same-date collisions become source revisions, competing ActEdition candidates, or validation-blocking conflicts before implementation.
findings.owner: S08 temporal model / future temporal proof slice
findings.resolution_path: Design conflict semantics with VERSION_OF, SUPERSEDES, and AMENDED_BY event behavior and add validation-report expectations for ambiguous same-date collisions.
findings.verification_criteria: Executable validation fixtures cover same-date multi-edition collisions and prove deterministic active_at/no-answer behavior.
findings.roadmap_effect: Blocks reliable temporal roadmap details for multi-source or conflicting consolidated editions; does not block single-source MVP import if ambiguity is rejected.

findings.title: Executable parser and retrieval golden tests are deferred proof gates

evidence.summary: FR-30 and 16_retrieval_eval.json skeleton exist, but tracked golden parser/retrieval fixtures and executable recall tests are not authored.
S05 verifies real ODT smoke evidence and parser direction only; it does not prove final legal hierarchy, SourceBlock, EvidenceSpan, or retrieval quality.

findings.impact: Parser or retrieval quality claims would be unsupported until real tracked fixtures exercise citation round-trips, no-answer behavior, and baseline recall.
findings.recommendation: Schedule golden parser/retrieval test authoring before any milestone depends on parser quality or retrieval recall metrics.
findings.owner: S08 validation/proof planning / future parser-retrieval proof slice
findings.resolution_path: Convert smoke evidence and FR-30 skeletons into tracked fixtures, expected outputs, no-answer cases, and recall metrics tied to parser-produced evidence IDs.
findings.verification_criteria: CI runs golden parser tests, citation round-trip checks, no-answer tests, and retrieval recall checks against tracked fixtures without reading ignored local-only artifacts.
findings.roadmap_effect: Required before claiming parser/retrieval quality in M002-M007; does not invalidate M001 architecture-only closure.
non_goals: Do not treat S05 marker/table counts as final legal extraction facts.

findings.title: Embedding offline/local language policy remains bounded by S09/S10 evidence

evidence.summary: S09 recommends USER-bge-m3 as practical baseline only by integration posture and excludes managed embedding APIs.
S10 confirms local/open-weight deepvk/USER-bge-m3 encode and live 1024-dimensional FalkorDB vector proof on this host; GigaEmbeddings remains blocked by safety/runtime gates.

findings.impact: Embedding architecture can cite a bounded local baseline but cannot claim production legal retrieval quality or managed API suitability.
findings.recommendation: Use USER-bge-m3 as the default local/open-weight runtime baseline for downstream planning; keep GigaEmbeddings as a deferred challenger and exclude managed GigaChat API paths.
findings.resolution_path: Repeat USER-bge-m3 proof on target hardware and evaluate parser-produced EvidenceSpan/SourceBlock fixtures before legal-quality or production SLO claims.
findings.verification_criteria: Future embedding proof records package/cache/download/runtime status, vector dimension, FalkorDB query proof, no raw vector leakage, and real evidence-backed retrieval metrics.
findings.roadmap_effect: No MVP impact while embeddings remain post-MVP; affects Phase 5/vector-search readiness and M002 proof budgeting.
non_goals: No production Russian legal retrieval quality claim from fixture-only metrics.

findings.title: FalkorDBLite to Docker migration failure-mode runbook is deferred

evidence.summary: Architecture text defines an evolution path but not a tested migration runbook.
S04 confirms bounded Docker FalkorDB and FalkorDBLite mechanics separately, not embedded-to-container migration safety.

findings.impact: Deployment milestones could overclaim safe embedded-to-container transition without export/import, persistence, rollback, auth/port, and smoke validation proof.
findings.recommendation: Add a migration runbook and smoke validation proof before any deployment milestone claims safe FalkorDBLite to Docker migration.
findings.owner: S08 deployment planning or later ops proof
findings.resolution_path: Define export/import, persistence checks, rollback path, port/auth configuration, and post-migration smoke commands as a deployment proof gate.
findings.verification_criteria: A later ops verifier runs migration dry-run/smoke checks and records terminal status, logs, rollback behavior, and configuration evidence.
findings.roadmap_effect: Does not block PRD consistency; must be resolved before deployment milestones depend on safe storage migration.
non_goals: Do not infer migration safety from separate FalkorDB and FalkorDBLite smoke success.

findings.title: FalkorDB runtime mechanics are confirmed only within the S04 smoke boundary

evidence.summary: S04 confirmed Docker daemon/image, basic graph, JavaScript UDF load/execute, procedure listing, full-text, vector mechanics at synthetic dimension 4, and FalkorDBLite basic/UDF/vector/full-text probes.

findings.impact: Architecture may rely on smoke-confirmed mechanics but cannot treat them as product suitability, production scale, legal retrieval quality, or GraphBLAS control-surface proof.
findings.recommendation: Cite S04 as bounded runtime capability evidence and keep production scale/legal-quality claims behind later proof gates.
findings.owner: S04 evidence owner / S08 final report
findings.resolution_path: Carry S04 terminal statuses into the final report and require later representative scale/source/API proof before promotion to product commitments.
findings.verification_criteria: S04 verifier command shape passes and S08 report labels S04 claims as bounded runtime mechanics, not production product proof.
findings.roadmap_effect: Supports selecting FalkorDB for continued architecture exploration while keeping deployment and legal-quality proof gates explicit.
non_goals: No direct LegalGraph GraphBLAS API/control surface claim.

findings.title: Real ODT parser evidence favors odfdo investigation but does not prove product extraction

evidence.summary: S05 uses raw content.xml traversal as ordering oracle, treats odfdo as current parser direction to investigate, and keeps odfpy as comparison evidence due to unmodified manifest loading failure.

findings.impact: Future parser/API guidance can choose an investigation direction, but final hierarchy, table reconciliation, SourceBlock, EvidenceSpan, and ETL behavior remain unproven.
findings.recommendation: Use odfdo as the current parser direction to investigate while preserving raw content.xml ordering as oracle and keeping odfpy behind an explicit manifest-cleaning boundary if ever used.
findings.owner: S05/S08 parser evidence consolidation / future parser implementation proof
findings.resolution_path: Build future parser tests from the real Garant ODT source and compare outputs against raw ordering before product ETL promotion.
findings.verification_criteria: S05 verifier passes; future parser tests prove unmodified-source loading or explicitly reviewed manifest-cleaning with source mutation=false.
findings.roadmap_effect: Guides M002 parser design but blocks final parser/product ETL claims until executable extraction proof exists.
non_goals: No final legal hierarchy extraction claim.

findings.title: Old_project artifacts remain prior art only

evidence.summary: S05 classifies Old_project candidates as adapt/defer or reject/defer; none are accepted unchanged because legacy ConsultantPlus WordML/XML assumptions do not establish behavior for current Garant ODT.

findings.impact: Blind legacy reuse could import stale source-format and semantic assumptions into the new architecture.
findings.recommendation: Mine Old_project only for vocabulary/API ideas after mapping to current parser evidence; reject keep-as-is reuse.
findings.owner: S08 final architecture review / future parser and API design owners
findings.resolution_path: Require each reused legacy idea to cite current ODT evidence, parser-direction proof, and an owner-specific verification criterion.
findings.verification_criteria: Final report and downstream designs classify legacy reuse as prior art and do not bless ConsultantPlus WordML/XML behavior for Garant ODT.
findings.roadmap_effect: Allows selective reuse of concepts while preventing legacy runtime assumptions from entering M002 implementation plans.

findings.title: USER-bge-m3 is the bounded local/open-weight runtime embedding baseline

evidence.summary: deepvk/USER-bge-m3 local encode completed, observed 1024 vector dimension, live FalkorDB 1024-dimensional vector index/query completed, and fixture-ID-only retrieval metrics were recorded.

findings.impact: Downstream architecture can use USER-bge-m3 as the practical runtime baseline without introducing managed embedding APIs.
findings.recommendation: Carry USER-bge-m3 forward as the default practical local/open-weight baseline and require real EvidenceSpan/SourceBlock evaluation before quality claims.
findings.owner: S10 evidence owner / future embedding proof owner
findings.resolution_path: Repeat runtime proof on target hardware and add real legal evidence-backed retrieval evaluation before production readiness.
findings.verification_criteria: Embedding verifier passes with no managed credential literals, no raw embedding leakage, package/cache/runtime evidence, and 1024-dimensional FalkorDB proof.
findings.roadmap_effect: Supports M002/M005 embedding planning as post-MVP proof work; does not change MVP scope.
non_goals: No production legal retrieval quality claim.

findings.title: GigaEmbeddings remains a blocked local challenger, not a default or managed fallback

evidence.summary: ai-sage/Giga-Embeddings-instruct cache is present but encode/vector proof is blocked by custom-code/trust_remote_code, flash-attn, acceleration/fallback, and no-swap gates.
S09 classifies GigaEmbeddings as a quality challenger with 2048-dimensional/custom-code/runtime risk and no legal-domain product proof.

findings.impact: Promoting GigaEmbeddings without gates would violate local safety assumptions and increase storage/runtime risk; replacing it with a managed API would violate D002.
findings.recommendation: Defer GigaEmbeddings as an M002 challenger only after explicit custom-code, trust_remote_code, flash-attn/CPU fallback, hardware, and no-swap gates are accepted and verified.
findings.resolution_path: Add a gated runtime task if the roadmap needs challenger evaluation; otherwise keep USER-bge-m3 as baseline.
findings.verification_criteria: Challenger proof records explicit gate approvals, package/runtime status, observed vector dimension, FalkorDB 2048-dimensional behavior, resource envelope, and retrieval metrics without managed API fallback.
findings.roadmap_effect: Does not block M001 closure or MVP scope; affects future quality-challenger evaluation budget.

findings.title: M001 remains architecture-only and must not ship product runtime behavior

evidence.summary: R011 forbids M001 from implementing product ETL, production graph schema, LegalNexus API, KnowQL parser, hybrid retrieval, or legal-answering runtime.

findings.impact: Final report guidance must not be mistaken for a production implementation or legal-answering product surface.
findings.recommendation: Keep S08 artifacts as review/reporting contracts only and route all implementation work into future milestones with proof gates.
findings.resolution_path: Final report and machine-readable findings must state non-goals and overclaim guardrails for product runtime, ETL, parser, API, retrieval, and legal-answering behavior.
findings.verification_criteria: S08 verifier rejects overclaim markers that promote architecture findings into production runtime, managed embedding API, final parser, product ETL, or legal-quality claims.
findings.roadmap_effect: Protects M001 closure while clarifying M002-M007 implementation boundaries.
